title: Drum and bass: liquid, neuro, jump-up, halftime; breaks, chops, reese and sub
doc: F minor, 172-176 bpm (setcpm(174/4)), one cycle = one bar on 16 steps. Two-step kick on 1 and the and of 3, snare on 2 and 4, ghost snares between; amen-style and think-style breaks are synthesised (no sampled breaks) and chopped by re-sequencing the bar's 16 slices; the low end is layered: a mono sine sub owns the fundamental, reese / neuro layers start at 100 Hz (multiband by layers). Racks follow docs/RACK_STANDARD.md.

section.title: DnB, electro, house / techno / trance: kits, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/dnb-electro (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 8-11, sources in docs/DNB_ELECTRO_REFERENCES.md). F minor throughout, one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps. Components are racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md; per-role classes reese, neuro, break, gate) and pattern atoms (dnb. drum-and-bass, el. electro, hs. house / techno / trance / big room, tn. tension and release); forms are gate atoms (dnb.intro .. dnb.outro on a 128-bar DnB form, el.* and hs.* on 8-bar sections, hs.map* on a 160-bar club map of 32-bar blocks); breaks are synthesised and chopped by re-sequencing the 16 slices of a bar (.bite(16, atoms.dnb.chops)); sidechain is first-class (kickPump moves the superdough duck onto the bass, chord and pad orbits; kickDuck wires a gain to kick:env). Seven feel templates (feel-liquid, -neuro, -jumpup, -electrohouse, -techno, -trance, -bigroom) fill the same slots as the phonk feels; their grooves are compositions of the standard presets (groove-swing | groove-push | groove-human with the voice seed).

racksDoc: Drum-and-bass, electro and house / techno / trance instrument racks (band-scoped, docs/RACK_STANDARD.md; per-role classes reese, neuro, break, gate), sidechain and filter moves. Bind into a slot: hooks.bind("kick", "dnbKick | groove-swing(54) | groove-human(2.5, 0.15, 1)").

atomsIngredient.title: DnB atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/dnb-electro drum-and-bass atoms (dnb.): two-step kick and snare, ghost notes and accents, amen-style and think-style breaks, chop orders for .bite(16, ...), shaker and ride, sub, reese, neuro, rolling and wobble lines, liquid chords, strings and vocal chops; gates of the 128-bar DnB form (intro, build, drop1, breakdown, build2, drop2, halftime, outro, drops, builds, vacuum). Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-dnb").

labels: four on the floor, offbeat hat, 124, 128

dnbKick.doc: DnB kick: short sine thump at 52 Hz, 24-semitone pitch knock, little tail so the sub keeps the low end

dnbSnare.doc: DnB snare: triangle body on G3 plus noise, bright crack, 170 Hz high-pass

ghostSnare.doc: ghost snare: the snare shorter, darker and quieter (ghost notes sit 10-15 dB under the backbeat)

breakKick.doc: break kick: a rounder, mid-heavy kick (a sampled 1960s funk kick has little sub), for amen / think style breaks

breakSnare.doc: break snare: higher, crackier body (A3) than dnbSnare

ride.doc: ride: long noise decay above 7.5 kHz

dnbShaker.doc: DnB shaker: soft-attack noise at 6 kHz up

dnbHat.doc: closed hat: very short noise above 8 kHz

dnbSub.doc: DnB sub: mono sine, 5 ms attack, held, low-passed at 250 Hz

reese.doc: reese mid layer: a dark saw on the sub's notes, high-passed at 100 Hz (24 dB/oct) so the sub keeps the fundamental; play it as a detuned pair, note(...).add(note("0,0.18")) (two oscillators 18 cents apart: the slow beating is the movement)

neuroBass.doc: neuro bass: FM saw (index 2.5, ratio 0.5 = sub-octave growl), resonant low-pass with a snap, vowel formant; serial drive is a move on top (glyphcore/edm drive(amt): shape / distort run as AudioWorklets, #140)

rollingBass.doc: rolling bass: dark saw, 4 ms attack, short filter blip per note

jumpWobble.doc: jump-up envelope wobble: resonant saw whose filter envelope re-opens on every note, so a 3+3+2 rhythm wobbles

liquidRhodes.doc: liquid Rhodes: FM sine (ratio 1, decaying index), high-passed at 120 Hz to stay off the bass

liquidPad.doc: liquid pad: native saw per chord note (a five-note voicing is wide enough; the supersaw worklet costs about 40x a native saw in the headless CLI), slow attack and filter swell, 5 Hz vibrato for movement

strings.doc: strings: sawtooth, 0.5 s attack, gentle 5 Hz vibrato

vocalChop.doc: vocal chop without samples: a short vowel-filtered saw (vary .vowel per note; real chops use word() or a vox bank)

kick.doc: two-step kick: 1 and the and of 3

snare.doc: backbeat on 2 and 4 (at 174 bpm: the snare every 0.69 s)

ghosts.doc: liquid ghost snares on beat 2.5 and 4.5

ghostsRoll.doc: rolling ghost snares (neuro / jump-up): around the backbeat, a pair into the next bar

ghostVel.doc: ghost accent table (a 16-step velocity; ghosts sit 10-15 dB under the backbeat)

halfSnare.doc: halftime snare on beat 3 (the 87 bpm feel inside 174)

hats.body: x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x ~

amenKick.doc: amen-style kick over 4 bars (bars 1-2 as commonly transcribed; bars 3-4 a variation, UNVERIFIED against the recording)

amenSnare.doc: amen-style snare over 4 bars (2, the a of 2, the e of 3, 4, the a of 4)

amenVel.doc: amen accent table: backbeats full, the in-between snares as ghosts

thinkKick.doc: think-style kick (a style, not a transcription)

chops.doc: chop order for .bite(16, ...): bar 1 as played, bar 2 repeats beat 1 on beat 3, bar 3 swaps beats 2 and 3, bar 4 ends in a stutter roll

chopsWild.doc: busier jungle chop order: doubled slices, a reversed beat, a closing roll

sub.doc: sub line: one note per bar, held (F1, Db2, Bb1, C2: 44-69 Hz), the second note on the kick at the and of 3

neuro.doc: neuro 16th riff over two bars, octave jumps

rolling.doc: rolling bass: offbeat 16ths that roll into the next kick, following the liquid chords (two bars each)

wobble.doc: jump-up wobble: 3+3+2 per half bar, octave jumps; each note re-opens the filter

chords.doc: liquid chords, one per two bars: Fm9, Dbmaj9, Bbm9, Cm7 (i, VI, iv, v)

strings.body: <g4 ab4 f4 ab4 f4 db5 eb4 g4>
strings.doc: string top line, one note per bar (the 9th / 3rd / 5th of each chord)

intro.doc: intro: bars 1-16 (form: intro 16, build 8, drop 1 32, breakdown 16, build 8, drop 2 32, halftime 8, outro 8 = 128 bars = 2:56.6 at 174 bpm)

noDrums.doc: drums out: first half of the intro and the breakdown

vacuum.doc: the last half bar before each drop: everything but the riser tail out

liquidPart.doc: the liquid half of the form (intro to the breakdown)

neuroPart.doc: the neuro half (build 2 to the end)

recipes.title: DnB two-step
recipes.intent: Kick on 1 and the and of 3, snare on 2 and 4, ghosts on 2.5 and 4.5, 8th hats: the basic drum-and-bass bar.

recipes.title: Ghost-note programming
recipes.intent: The backbeat full, ghost snares 10-15 dB under it in a rolling pattern; the accent table is a 16-step velocity.

recipes.title: Amen-style break (synthesised)
recipes.intent: A four-bar amen-style break from a kick, a crackier snare with ghost accents and an 8th ride; no sample.

recipes.title: Amen chops (slice re-sequencing)
recipes.intent: The same break chopped: every lane is cut into the bar's 16 slices and re-sequenced by one chop order (.bite(16, ...)), so kick, snare and ride stay in step.

recipes.title: Jungle chops (busier order)
recipes.intent: Doubled slices, a reversed beat and a closing roll from a second chop order.

recipes.title: Think-style break (synthesised)
recipes.intent: A think-style pattern: kick on 1 and the a of 1, snare on 2, the a of 2, 4 and the and of 4, 16th hats with accents.

recipes.title: DnB sub
recipes.intent: Mono sine sub, one held note per bar on F1 / Db2 / Bb1 / C2, retriggered with the kick.

recipes.title: Reese bass
recipes.intent: Two detuned saws on the sub's notes from 100 Hz up: the slow beating of the pair is the movement.

recipes.title: Neuro bass
recipes.intent: FM saw with a sub-octave modulator, resonant snap and vowel formant on a 16th neuro riff (serial drive is the edm drive move on top).

recipes.title: Rolling bass
recipes.intent: A dark saw on offbeat 16ths that roll into the next kick.

recipes.title: Jump-up wobble
recipes.intent: Resonant saw whose filter re-opens on every note of a 3+3+2 rhythm with octave jumps.

recipes.title: Liquid Rhodes comp
recipes.intent: FM Rhodes playing Fm9 - Dbmaj9 - Bbm9 - Cm7, one chord per two bars, in a syncopated comp.

recipes.title: Liquid pad
recipes.intent: Supersaw pad swelling over the liquid chords, low end left to the bass.

recipes.title: Strings top line
recipes.intent: A slow string line, one note per bar, on the 9th / 3rd / 5th of each chord.

recipes.title: Vocal chops (no samples)
recipes.intent: Short vowel-filtered saw chops on an offbeat rhythm, the vowel changing every bar.

recipes.title: Halftime DnB
recipes.intent: Same tempo, kick on 1 and snare on 3: the 87 bpm feel, while the shaker and the bass keep running at 174.

recipes.title: Multiband by layers: sub + reese
recipes.intent: The low end in two layers: a mono sine sub owns 40-120 Hz, the reese plays the same notes from 100 Hz up, so the movement never smears the sub.

recipes.title: Shaker and ride
recipes.intent: 16th shaker accented on the offbeat 8ths, an 8th ride on top.

syntax.title: DnB form as gates (intro, build, drop, vacuum)
syntax.code:
setcpm(174/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-dnb")
hooks.bind("kick", "dnbKick"); hooks.bind("snare", "dnbSnare"); hooks.bind("sub", "dnbSub"); hooks.bind("pad", "liquidPad")
hooks.bind("pad", [["lpf", 500]], atoms.dnb.intro)   // filter move: the intro pad is dark, the drop opens it
kick: s(atoms.dnb.kick).use("kick").tags("drums")
snare: s(atoms.dnb.snare).use("snare").tags("drums")
sub: note(atoms.dnb.sub).use("sub").tags("low")
pad: note(atoms.dnb.chords).use("pad")
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.dnb.intro)
tagged("low").mute("<25b")
tagged("drums | low").mute(atoms.dnb.vacuum)

syntax.title: Amen chops: one chop order on every lane (.bite)
Multiband by layers: sub + reese + neuro on a glued bass bus
syntax.code:
setcpm(174/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-dnb")
kick: s(atoms.dnb.kick).hook("dnbKick").tags("drums")
snare: s(atoms.dnb.snare).hook("dnbSnare").tags("drums")
sub: note(atoms.dnb.sub).hook("dnbSub").tags("low")          // 40-120 Hz, mono, clean
reese: note(atoms.dnb.sub).add(note("0,0.18")).hook("reese").tags("mid")   // the same notes from 100 Hz up, a pair 18 cents apart
neuro: note(atoms.dnb.neuro).hook("neuroBass").velocity(0.8).tags("mid")
bassbus: ret("bassbus").compressor("-22:4:6:.005:.12").gain(0.6)   // bus processing: parallel glue on the mid layers
tagged("mid").send("bassbus", 0.5)

syntax.title: Chop a real break (needs a break sample)
syntax.skip: needs a sample bank (dirt-samples breaks) not rendered offline
syntax.code:
setcpm(174/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/dnb-electro:atoms-dnb")
samples('github:tidalcycles/dirt-samples')   // a break you have the rights to; the slices are re-sequenced by the same chop orders
$: s("breaks165").fit().slice(16, atoms.dnb.chops).hook("hygiene-break").gain(0.8)
